chunks: Ali ibn Ahmad narrated to us, from Ubaydillah ibn Musa al-Alawi, from Abdullah ibn Muhammad, who said: Muhammad ibn Khalid narrated to us, from al-Hasan ibn al-Mubarak, from Abu Ishaq al-Hamdani, from al-Harith al-Hamdani, from Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) that he said:

Al-Mahdi will come, curly-haired, with a mole on his cheek; his beginning will be from the East. And when that occurs, As-Sufyani will rise, and he will rule for the duration of a woman's pregnancy, nine months. He will emerge in Sham, and the people of Sham will submit to him except for some groups who remain steadfast upon the truth, whom Allah preserves from going out with him. He will come to Medina with a mighty army until when he reaches the desert of Medina, Allah will cause the earth to swallow him,
And that is the saying of Allah in His Book: 'And could you see when they shall become terrified, but (then) there shall be no escape and they shall be seized upon from a near place.'

key_terms.السُّفْيَانِيُّ: As-Sufyani, a specific figure who rises before Al-Mahdi
key_terms.الْمَهْدِيُّ: Al-Mahdi (the Guided One), the twelfth Imam
key_terms.بَيْدَاءِ الْمَدِيَنَة: The desert of Medina, the location of the swallowing of As-Sufyani's army
key_terms.خَسَفَ اللَّهُ بِهِ: Allah caused the earth to swallow him

ai.seo_question: What is the relationship between the rise of As-Sufyani and Al-Mahdi according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from Al-Nu'mani’s *Kitab al-Ghayba* outlines the eschatological rivalry between the Sufyani, whose tyranny is limited to nine months, and Al-Mahdi, who emerges from the East. The text explicitly links the Sufyani’s defeat in Medina to Quran 41:51, a verse traditionally interpreted in Shia exegesis as describing the divine 'earth-swallowing' (khasf) of the tyrant's army, thereby validating the prophetic tradition through scriptural authority.

en.abdullah-al-shahin: (14) Ali bin Ahmad narrated from Obaydillah bin Musa al-Alawi from Abdullah bin Muhammad from Muhammad bin Khalid from al-Hasan bin al-Mubarak from Abu Iss’haq al-Hamadani from al-Harith al-Hamadani that Amirul Mo’mineen (as) had said:

“Al-Mahdi (aj) will come from the east but before that as-Sufyani will rise in Sham. He (as-Sufyani) will rule for nine months only. All the people of Sham will submit to him except a very few believers, who will still keep to the truth and whom Allah preserves from following him. He will move towards Medina with a great army but when they reach the desert of Medina, Allah will make the desert sink with them.
It is the saying of Allah in His holy Book, ‘And could you see when they shall become terrified, but (then) there shall be no escape and they shall be seized upon from a near place.’”
